title: Retired product names
routing: Is this about retired product names in public copy: the retired-terms rule that `inixiative-config check` runs (alone: `inixiative-config terms [dir] [--write-baseline]`), RETIRED_TERMS and their replacements in src/retiredTerms.ts, or a repo's scripts/ci/retired-terms/allow.txt and baseline.txt? Jobs: CI failed on an old name in a README, doc or package description, rewrite to the current name, allow a legitimate use, baseline uses that predate the rule, add a newly retired word, adopt the rule in a repo's own CI.
